svg.text: Round 1, greyscale. Shown at 64, 32 and 16 px.
A scrollbar read as a depth gauge: the
thumb sits deep on a sounding scale.
A sounding line drops through the feed to
Feed cards shrink as they recede: the
deeper you scroll, the further away.
Down, then back up: every metre scrolled is
A footprint built from feed rows: scrolling
Stairs going down; you climb back up on
Rounded screens nested into a shaft that
Chevrons thin and narrow as they dive:
A scroll thumb with a frost crystal cut out
A paper scroll unrolling into a measuring
